title: Batched Pandora's Box — one adaptive run (k=2, T=1/5)

ops.caption: Batch 1 opens box 1 and box 2 together: cost 1/5 + 1/5 + setup 1/5 = 3/5. Box 1 always shows 1/2.
Box 2 shows 1/2 this run (it could have been 0 or 99 — see the other scene).
Cost so far: 3/5 (two box costs + one setup).
Best so far: 1/2. Box 2 didn't show 99, so compare: a second batch (box 3 alone) costs 1 + 1/5 = 6/5 and gains 10 − 1/2 with probability 1/5, expected 1.9 > 1.2 — worth opening.
Batch 2: box 3 opens alone (k=2 is a cap, not a requirement). It shows 10.

ops.note: Final score = best 10 − total cost 9/5 = 8.2. (The paper's bound: reacting between batches beats any fixed menu of batches by at most 2×; on this instance about 1.19×.)
